**Unsure (3 accounts, 2 policy rows):**

Under case_404 I only checked the subject's records, which don't list either account; I didn't search the accounts directly. - **activity_1006 (account_2191):** searching the account under case_394 and case_406 found nothing. Both cases are possible on timing (it falls after each request and before each reported time).

For case_406, the other candidate on activity_1033, evidence_70 was captured after its audit time, so it can't count. That doesn't show they belong to no case here, so I didn't reject them.

One check is left: I didn't run `resolve_identity` for case_377 or case_380. If either subject had earlier identifiers that match those analytics records, activity_1033 or activity_1081 could be assigned instead.
